claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: Rancor was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-mitre-enterprise-intrusion-set, misp-mitre-intrusion-set, misp-threat-actor.
